name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (gfx/paint domain). Accurately reflects purpose: paint the RIGHT status panel layer of the slide-animated status screen. No Ghidra address residue. Sister-named with fd2_paint_status_panel_layer_left; consistent.
purpose: Copy the RIGHT status panel (86 rows x 223 bytes) from a source buffer into the render workspace, applying signed VERTICAL-shift clipping so the panel can be drawn part-way off the top screen edge during the status-screen slide animation.
logic_summary: row_count=0x56, src_y_skip=0. If y_offset<0 (panel pushed off top edge): row_count = y_offset+0x56 (shortened copy), src_y_skip = -y_offset (advance source rows so visible part stays aligned), y_offset = 0 (clamp dst row base). Then for row in [0,row_count): memmove(dst_workspace + 0x5C + (y_offset+row)*0x140, src_buffer + 0x91C + (src_y_skip+row)*0x140, 0xDF). Stride 0x140 = 320 px/row. Dst col base 0x5C (row 0); src base 0x91C = row 7*0x140 + 0x5C (right panel sits 7 rows below source-buffer head). Compiler-injected __CHK(0x20) stack probe precedes the body.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_paint_status_panel_layer_right(uint32 y_offset, uint32 dst_workspace, uint32 src_buffer)

params.name: y_offset
params.semantics: Signed vertical destination shift in rows. >=0 draws in place at base; <0 pushes the panel off the top edge (copy shortened, source advanced, dst clamped to row 0). Caller fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step passes 7 - 16*(frame-3) for slide frames.
params.reason: Accurately names the signed vertical row shift; matches body usage (compared <0, added to dst row index) and caller intent. No address residue. Distinct from sister-left's x_offset (horizontal).

params.name: dst_workspace
params.semantics: Linear address of the 320-byte-stride offscreen render workspace (the `workspace` buffer the caller composites to 0xA0000). Destination of the per-row memmove at base offset 0x5C.
params.reason: Correctly identifies the destination render workspace; matches caller passing its `workspace` arg. No address residue.

params.name: src_buffer
params.semantics: Linear address of the source panel-data buffer holding the assembled status-screen art; the right panel resides 7 rows below its head (offset 0x91C). Source of the per-row memmove.
params.reason: Correctly identifies the source art buffer; matches caller passing its `src_buffer` arg. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the row-by-row blit into dst_workspace.
